# The Linux kit's Python tools (tools/linux-kit/kit.sh deps, and
# spikes/tools/windows-deps.sh for aqtinstall): pip, meson, aqtinstall
# (Qt) and jinja2 (libplacebo's build), with what they need, each at one
# version and installed with --require-hashes. The hashes are those of the
# files a Linux x86_64 CPython 3.10 or later installs (source archives,
# pure wheels, manylinux x86_64 wheels). Made from those four names with
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.10 --generate-hashes
#     --exclude-newer 2026-11-18T19:00:00Z
# (the versions the first alpha was built with), the other systems'
# wheels and PyPy's packages left out.
